speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing progressive difficulty walking, urinary incontinence, and speech difficulties. To begin our assessment, have these symptoms been present for a long time, or did they start suddenly?

speaker: Patient
text: 54-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing a gradual difficulty in walking over the past 3 months, requiring wheelchair assistance for the last month. Additionally, there is a history of urinary incontinence for 1 year and recent onset of speech slurring making communication challenging.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. You mentioned a 1-year history of urinary incontinence, but the walking and speech issues only started 3 months ago and are getting worse; are these symptoms affecting the right side of your body more than the left, or is it equally on both sides?
